_note: Technical sheets transcribed from the client's documents (docs/VALLO_*.pdf, edition of 10 November 2026). Only what those sheets confirm is here: a figure they mark as unconfirmed — total height, most seat depths, box sizes, the foam in the spring-mesh seats — is left out, never estimated. Where a sheet and an older workshop sketch disagree, the sheet wins (client's instruction, 2026-11-11) and the sketch is flagged `approximate` in curation.json. media.mjs merges this into each piece; emit.mjs writes `figures`, `figuresNote` and `specs` into its detail file.
